    """Merge overlapping or touching intervals.

    Given a list of [start, end] pairs (start <= end, any order), return a
    list of disjoint [start, end] intervals sorted by start. Intervals that
    overlap or touch (e.g. [1, 3] and [3, 5]) are merged. The input list and
    its sublists are not modified.
    """
    if not intervals:
        return []

    sorted_intervals = sorted([list(iv) for iv in intervals], key=lambda iv: (iv[0], iv[1]))

    merged = [list(sorted_intervals[0])]
    for start, end in sorted_intervals[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if start <= last[1]:
            if end > last[1]:
                last[1] = end
        else:
            merged.append([start, end])

    return merged
